settings.title: JW PowerCache Settings
settings.description: Caches only verified guest public APIs with generation invalidation. Start in observe mode.
settings.safety_notice: Run php artisan power-cache:doctor before active mode. The file store requires an explicit single-node environment acknowledgement.
settings.loading_ux_intro: Independently of cache mode, replace only page-level and large content loading with structural skeletons. Button and modal action spinners stay unchanged.

fields.mode_hint: Observe records eligibility without storing or serving HITs; only active serves cache.
fields.store_driver_hint: Use file on one node and a dedicated Redis connection for multi-node production.
fields.cache_public_categories: Public ecommerce category tree and details
fields.loading_ux_enabled_hint: Turning this off immediately restores the native G7 spinner behavior.
fields.loading_ux_scope_hint: Apply to user screens, administrator screens, or both.
fields.loading_ux_delay_hint: Prevents flashes on short responses. No minimum display time is forced after a response completes.
fields.loading_ux_iteration_hint: Number of repeated placeholders in list, card, and form skeletons.
fields.retention_hint: This is garbage-collection retention, not a freshness TTL.
